description: This is a JUnit test class for the DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler, testing its behavior under various delivery outcomes such as Accepted, Rejected, Modified, Released, as well as failure scenarios during message sending and sender creation.

classes.name: DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler's behavior with different delivery states and failure scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures and mock objects before each test.

methods.description: Tests behavior when the message sender returns a Rejected delivery result.

methods.name: testHandleWithModifiedDeliveryResult
